name: steel
lore_descriptor: blued and well-tempered, the plain good work of a smith who knew the trade
first_pickup_chronicle: Steel. Iron, grown up. It will hold an edge longer than I am likely to live. Low bar, but still.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.20, weight_mult 0.95, no effective_against (T3 core). 20% better than iron, slightly LIGHTER — refining process. The upgrade from iron, on schedule with the L18-22 first 'real' loot wave.
